narrative:
## Handover Summary — Cost-to-Serve by Contract

Agent cost, telephony, IT and overhead allocated per contract via the governed call-type → contract → service-area mapping.

## Key Decisions
• 120 CSPS surge FTE released from Q4 (−GBP 9M)
• Citizen contact overheads re-allocated by handled minutes; four sub-5% contracts flagged for renewal pricing (−GBP 7M)
• Regulated Services stranded cost exited in step with handbacks (−GBP 7M)

signals.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
signals.source: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
signals.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.
